notes.title: Hotfix #6 🔥
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've fixed the save issue caused by the vending machine and cleaning robot, where purchasing certain upgrades would disappear. This issue was causing all save data to become corrupted. Unfortunately, if your game is still stuck, you might need to restart again. We apologize for the inconvenience. 

Please let us know if you encounter anything else.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Pawn Planet 0.62 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this patch includes some fixes and changes;


Improved game loading time.
You can now drop the vending machine box and take it back.
Some repair machine and vending machine fixes.
Added a notification when trying to pick up boxes while the shop is open.
Inverse mouse fixed to only work on the Y-axis.
Gamble money now saves correctly.
Heist enemy AI improvements.
The cleaning robot no longer collides with customers.
Fixed shop floor hex design. The color red now shows up correctly instead of purple.
Fixed being able to use wall paints before purchasing them.
Fixed an issue where music sometimes stops.
Other minor fixes.


Please let us know if you encounter any bug.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Shop Customization Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The Shop Update is here!

Thank you all for your patience and support. We hope you enjoy this update.

Features
New Shop Design
We've decided to focus more on shop customization, as it was limited, and we cannot build upon it. As a result, we've redesigned the shop to make it more customizable. You can now expand the shop multiple times and change wall colors as well as purchase additional shelves. These changes will also allow us to add more machines to the backroom in the future and improve the late game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/e35de3b8675fd762d917fb526e67fc807919704d.png
You can also upgrade the shop even further now!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/d44013dd7eb725315e2c76a7cf27539d62380782.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/1b4962a0fefcac0389b16dcc0eb0beff8d59e074.png

Customization
You can now purchase different wall, door colors and floor textures!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/a8f10f8c50ee71cf097bb87daa31ecaa6cd2b605.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/5cd0fe98437c71d6e80e0b94a0ba17fcbaa8d49e.png

Additional Shelves
You can now purchase new shelves and place them however you like!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/45397b301606a9810ebcfa95d50d08923eeace11.gif

Home
Who doesn't love it's own home? Now you can purchase your own house and decorate it! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/b8c90ae6d72fccc3dfcc5a90655355c6b700ccc8.png


General Improvements

Added 7 new items.
Added new customer models.
Added inverse mouse settings.
Instead of quitting you can now return to the menu.
Added typing numbers to the casino bets.
Graphic quality options.
Added trash bin to the auction planets

Bug fixes

Fixed thief sometimes drops an unpickable item.
Fixed unable to withdraw stackable items from storage when inventory is full.
Fixed some bugs related to the repair machine.


Since this update changes some in-game stuff, please let us know if you encounter a bug. We hope you enjoy this update. 
Thank you!

notes.title: Hotfix #3 🔥
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We’ve addressed some issues you may have encountered and improved a few gameplay elements:


 Added a quick accept button without needing to type the same offer as the customer.
 Improved character spawn FX (this should hopefully fix some FPS drops when customers spawn).
 Fixed various vending machine bugs.
 Resolved an issue where you could purchase an item from a customer while your inventory was full.
 Fixed the inventory full notification not stopping.
 Fixed spaceship sound playing when SFX sound is set to 0.
 Made other small changes and fixes.


Have fun, and please report any bugs you encounter!

notes.title: Hotfix #1 🔥
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We just addressed some of the issues you may have encountered, including some game-breaking bugs.

Improvements

 Added remaining rent day and price to the UI.
 Added a mouse sensitivity option to the in-game menu.
 Changed some translation on German language.

Fixes

 Fixed a game-breaking bug when the player deals with a customer.
 Fixed a game-over bug in blackjack.
 Fixed the return of the heist results a day/night cycle.

Have fun and please report any bugs you encounter.
